title: Peloton Tread+ Treadmill Safety Incident
summary: A short silent video from the US Consumer Product Safety Commission warning consumers to stop using the Peloton Tread+. It shows a child being pulled under the treadmill, and it preceded Peloton's recall.
why: HN cites it as evidence in debates over the treadmill's design flaw and parental responsibility, often with a warning that it is disturbing.
